description: Recover embedded Kinect Adventures photos into a ZIP. Inputs stay unchanged.
inputs_help: exported Xbox photo files (any extension), or directories with --recursive
output_help: new destination ZIP; existing files are never overwritten
recursive_help: include files in input directories and their subdirectories
input_missing: Input is not a regular file or directory: {path}
output_exists: Output already exists; choose a new ZIP path: {path}
output_in_inputs: The destination cannot be one of the input files.
file_too_large: File exceeds the 128 MiB limit; select individual exported photo files.
scan_budget: File is too complex or damaged to scan within the safety limit.
read_error: Cannot read this file. Check permissions and try again.
no_photos: No complete JPEG found. Select exported photo files such as PM9_*, not GameProgress or SouvenirRecording.
summary: Recovered {photos} photos from {files} files; skipped {skipped}; failed {failed}. ZIP: {path}
